about: HORDE gates that fail for a reason outside Loupe, each pinned to exactly what it waits on (Julian, 2026-10-18: full stays red, but says why). ./verify full exits 4 (not 1) only when every failing gate is listed here with exactly these ids and every snapshot byte-compare held; tools/gate.test.mjs fails if an entry names a passing gate or other ids, so a stale entry cannot linger and a new unknown cannot hide behind an old reason.
